 remove it.

Beneath the shaft end on a wooden blocks of suitable high to avoid bending.

 rope.

Sling the column pipe (711.01), connect it with the column pipe (711.02) 
 diagonally and gradually bang the shaft.
Sling the propeller bowl (104), connect it with the column pipe (711.01).
Mount the key (940.01)
Sling the impeller and mount it on the pump shaft.
Sling the wear plate (135) and connect it with the propeller bowl.
Check the radial clearance of impeller blades with wear plate.
Mount the split ring (501) and assemble the hub cap nut (260).

Mount the lock washer and screw the locking screw 
 (906).
Assemble the thrust bearing as follow.

Assemble the thrust pads on their support face push in radial under the 
 locating lip on the top of base plate.
Insert pads stop and check clearance between pads and stops.

With shaft support screw the collar and lock in position using bolts and lock 
 washer.
Insert journal pad stops into housing and screw it to base plate.

Assemble journal pads into housing mount complete upper thrust ring assemble 
 into housing and screw it.
Place jointing on base plate and assemble casing to base plate.
Mount the top cover to casing and screw it.
Assemble fan completely on top of collar and screw with grub screw.
Assemble the temperature sensor.
Assemble half fan shrouds screw it with casing.
Mount air vent and fit the drain plug with base plate.
Insert the stuffing box with a new packing cords.
Rotate the pump rotor and ascertain that it is easy rotating
Lift the pump, place it in sump.
Mount all hydraulic, and instruments and electric connections.
Charge oil for thrust bearing.
Lift the pump motor on its place.
Adjust the align mint between motor shaft and pump and record it.
Couple the motor completely with the pump shaft.
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked.
Check the oil level in the thrust bearing.

Check the direction of rotation of the pump by pushing the electric button 
 instantly.
The temperature of thrust bearing.
Any water and oil leakage.
Discharge quantity, pressure and record them.
Check vibration level and record it.

Introduction
This document outlines the
Major Maintenance Procedures P2, which must be carried out 
every four years as 
indicated by Y4 in the above title block. 
This pump is used 
to transfer sea water from intake to condenser.

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.

 is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety healthy,

Tools and Equipment
Complete maintenance tool set.
Ropes, and wooden blocks.
Vibrometer, Feeler gauge, dial indicator.
Cleaning fluid.
Work to be Carried Out
Before Pump Shut Down
Check discharge pressure and record them.
Check the vibration level of the pump and record it.
Pump Shut Down
Measure the alignment and record it.
Disassembly
Un couple the electric motor from the pump and lift it, lean it on a wooden 
 blokes to avoid damage of the half coupling.
Dismantle hydraulic, instruments and remove them.
Drain the oil from thrust support.
Dismantle the discharge flange.
Dismantle the frame from the foundation base plate.
Sling the pump, lift it from the sump, leave it for a few minutes to drain it 
 completely.
Measure the radial clearance of blades and record it (0.5 1.25 mm).
Lean the pump in a horizontal position with the discharge hole on the ground 
 with a wooden blocks to avoid damage of discharge hole.
Place the discharge column on a wooden blocks of suitable high for easy 
 disassembly.
Disassembly of Impeller
Sling the bell mouth (138), disconnect it from the wear plate and remove it.
Straighten the lock washer (931.1), unscrew the impeller locking screw (906), 
 remove the impeller hub cap (260) and split ring (501).
Sling the wear plate (135), disconnect it from the propeller bowl (104) and 
 remove it.
Sling the impeller (252), un thread it and remove the key (940.1).
Beneath the shaft end on a wooden blocks of suitable high to avoid bending.
Disassembly of Thrust 
Bearing
Remove the temperature sensor and air vent.
Dismantle fan shrouds.
Dismantle the fan and top cover.
Dismantle upper retaining ring and lift out journal pads for inspection.
Disassembly of Upper 
Parts
Dismantle the support and loosen the stuffing box.
Dismantle the rigid coupling connecting the hollow shaft (213) with the inter 
 mediate shaft (212).
Disconnect motor stool (341) from the column pipe (711.02), unthreaded it 
 along the shaft. Keep items horizontally to avoid sliding of the shaft.
Sling the column pipe (711.01), unthread it along the shaft and keep it 
 horizontally.
Sling the inter mediate shaft (212), slightly put under stress the lifting 
 rope.
Sling the propeller bowl (104), disconnect it from the column section 
 (711.01), insert some supports beneath the shaft end.
Dismantle the inter mediate coupling (848) and disconnect the pump shaft (211) 
 from the inter mediate shaft (212).
Inspection
Check the blades for ( wear corrosion cracks ).
Check the shaft run out( 0.03 mm).
Check the sliding bearing surface anti wear and scratches.
Check all protection sleeves of the shaft and replace them if it is needs.
Replace all gaskets.
Check all keys and the tie bolts and replace them if it is needs.
Assembly
Sling the column pipe (711.02). connect it with the motor stool (341).
Sling the inter mediate shaft (212), keep it horizontally insert it and 
 connect with the hollow shaft by a rigid coupling.
Sling the pump shaft (211), connect it with the inter mediate shaft by the 
 inter mediate coupling (848), beneath the shaft with a wooden blocks of 
 suitable high to avoid bending.
Sling the column pipe (711.01), connect it with the column pipe (711.02) 
 diagonally and gradually bang the shaft.
Sling the propeller bowl (104), connect it with the column pipe (711.01).
Mount the key (940.01)
Sling the impeller and mount it on the pump shaft.
Sling the wear plate (135) and connect it with the propeller bowl.
Check the radial clearance of impeller blades with wear plate.
Mount the split ring (501) and assemble the hub cap nut (260).
Mount the lock washer and screw the locking screw 
 (906).
Assembly of Thrust Bearing
Assemble the thrust bearing as follow.
Assemble the thrust pads on their support face push in radial under the 
 locating lip on the top of base plate.
Insert pads stop and check clearance between pads and stops.
With shaft support screw the collar and lock in position using bolts and lock 
 washer.
Insert journal pad stops into housing and screw it to base plate.
Assemble journal pads into housing mount complete upper thrust ring assemble 
 into housing and screw it.
Place jointing on base plate and assemble casing to base plate.
Mount the top cover to casing and screw it.
Assemble fan completely on top of collar and screw with grub screw.
Assemble the temperature sensor.
Assemble half fan shrouds screw it with casing.
Mount air vent and fit the drain plug with base plate.
Insert the stuffing box with a new packing cords.
Rotate the pump rotor and ascertain that it is easy rotating
Lift the pump, place it in sump.
Mount all hydraulic, and instruments and electric connections.
Charge oil for thrust bearing.
Lift the pump motor on its place.
Adjust the align mint between motor shaft and pump and record it.
Couple the motor completely with the pump shaft.
Starting the Pump
Before starting the pump, the following steps should be checked.
Check the oil level in the thrust bearing.
Check the direction of rotation of the pump by pushing the electric button 
 instantly.
Attendance and Checking
The temperature of thrust bearing.
Any water and oil leakage.
Discharge quantity, pressure and record them.
Check vibration level and record it.
